name: ASCII Shockwave
description: Dot-matrix terminal blast fronts: an eight-glyph 4x6 ROM is indexed by box-averaged cell luminance, and the ASCII region is the union of a continuous pointer pulse with every bounded click front, each expanding at its own rate with a trailing wake. Ring spacing is banded by the FFT, crests split chromatically, and glyphs leave a decaying phosphor trace.

updatedParams.name: Wave Speed
updatedParams.description: Propagation rate of the pointer pulse and click fronts.

updatedParams.name: Source Tint
updatedParams.description: Blend from terminal phosphor green toward the source colour.

updatedParams.name: Phosphor Persistence
updatedParams.description: Decay rate of the glyph afterimage through dataTextureC.
